parameter.help: Sliding window length (minutes); each window fits its own template of the unit, so the unit's drift is followed.
Window step (minutes); each spike takes the fit of the window whose centre is nearest.
A field is present at or above this matched-filter SNR (noise-sd units). Noise gives ~1-3% at 4.
Most children per unit (time bins coarsen until the classes fit).
Time bins the children are split into (0 = one child per class over the whole span).

The waveform space the fields are fitted in: the variant of a .spk the session holds (standard = raw; stderiv; a whitened space). Every .spk variant of the group is in the sub-session. The noise covariance comes from the matching .nst, else the unit's own baseline.

Channels the field is fitted on: off = the unit's off-spike channels only (the neighbours' fields; the unit's own template stays out of the fit), full = every channel of the group, the unit's own included (misfit and collisions on its own channels become fields too; position spans the whole group).
A channel is off-spike when the unit's template trough on it is below this fraction of the deepest channel's.

The fiber-kit.yaml this run uses (knobs AND the one-step plan). `fk install klusters-plugin` sets it to the fiber-kit-klusters-manifold.yaml installed beside this descriptor. Edit that file for the remaining FK_MANIFOLD_* knobs (position bins, dead time, ISI flag, jobs).
Waveform variant of the run (%variant = the open clustering's).

program.help: Fit the off-spike-channel field manifold of the selected unit(s) in sliding windows and install it as their children: per time bin, 'plain' (no field) and field classes by source position and timing (before / coincident with / after the spike). Also writes the per-spike manifold coordinates as the feature space `manifold` (Space selector): SNR, lag, position, decay, amplitude, window, class, ISI flag, dominant-channel amplitude. Nothing moves between units; the children are a view of one unit.
